architecture: Native WPF UI + fixed-command Windows service + bundled PowerShell 7.6.6 + leak-closed direct-IP ctrld DoH + accepted zapret/winws/WinDivert multiprotocol engine with Targeted/All Sites scope control
validationBoundary: Direct Internet Method does not change public egress IP; remote country/account/product restrictions are outside direct DNS/DPI control.
Gemini returns HTTP 403 on the validated IR egress in both curl and real headless Chrome. A usable Gemini page requires a separate egress-changing architecture.
Adult coverage uses a maintained opt-in catalog plus bounded host-specific profiles. Windows stable-state representative probes return HTTP 200 for Pornhub, RedTube, XVideos, XNXX and XHamster.

XHamster currently resolves to Cloudflare 104.16.3.81 and 104.16.4.81: 104.16.4.81 is repeatably HTTP 200 while 104.16.3.81 is repeatably TCP-connect timeout. A cold first probe can therefore fail depending on CDN edge selection; pinning a shared Cloudflare edge is rejected as brittle/system-risky.
Linux representative matrix passes Pornhub, RedTube, XVideos and XNXX; XHamster remains a platform/network-path-specific TLS/edge limitation after bounded upstream/comparable strategy exhaustion.
HTTP 4xx/5xx is not accepted as usable-page PASS.
Targeted remains the default scope; All Sites is explicit opt-in.
exactNextAction: Commit final candidate metadata, rebuild one exact Windows artifact from that committed source, install/verify exact identity plus live Start/site/rollback, require protected CI on the exact final branch head, then publish v1.5.1 only if all gates pass.
